scope.purpose: Identify and qualify a historical VCFv4.0 normative source without conflating the core format specification with 1000 Genomes Project producer conventions or structural-variation extensions.

source_discovery.title: VCF (Variant Call Format) version 4.0
source_discovery.observed_scope: Core VCF v4.0 text: metadata, header syntax, fixed fields, INFO, FORMAT, GT and haplotype representation.

web_evidence.corroboration: VCFtools historical specifications page states that older VCF 4.0 specification documents are hosted on the 1000 Genomes wiki; IGSR page identifies itself as VCF version 4.0; current HTS index identifies VCFv4.1-4.5 as successor specifications.

source_discovery.provenance_assessment: The VCFtools historical index and IGSR page independently corroborate the historical location and VCFv4.0 identity of the core specification. The core page contains the version-specific format description, while the separate SV page explicitly labels its content as 1000 Genomes project conventions/extensions. However, exact immutable source-byte identity and complete original release provenance remain unverified. A 2026-11-07 direct line-anchored inspection of the detailed rendered page further corroborates VCFv4.0 FORMAT semantics (GT presence/order, GL biallelic applicability, and reserved FORMAT field typing), but does not change the raw-source qualification blocker.

raw_source_capture.reason: Only rendered/search-indexed HTML text was retrievable. The raw-export endpoint was inaccessible and no authoritative original PDF/TeX/source archive was located. Do not reconstruct HTML or hash rendered text as a substitute.

Lines 0-2 identify VCFv4.0 and separate 1000 Genomes SV conventions; lines 23-26 show example GT/GQ/DP/HQ header definitions; lines 43-58 describe optional but well-formed metadata and FORMAT Types; lines 108-120 specify GT-first/all-sample GT, DP, FT, GL biallelic restriction, GQ/HQ numeric semantics and non-droppable GT. This is rendered-page evidence only, not an immutable raw-source capture.

source_discovery.title: Encoding Structural Variants in VCF (Variant Call Format) version 4.0
source_discovery.provenance_assessment: The page explicitly describes conventions and extensions adopted by the 1000 Genomes Project for structural-variation encoding in VCF 4.0. It is not the core VCFv4.0 normative specification.
limitations: Keep separate from core VCFv4.0 requirements.
Do not generalize producer conventions to all VCFv4.0 producers or readers without independent normative evidence.

separation_rules: Core VCFv4.0 syntax and semantics must be sourced from the historical VCFv4.0 specification, not inferred from 1000 Genomes example files.
1000 Genomes producer conventions, project-specific INFO tags and data-release conventions must be registered separately as PRODUCER_CONVENTION sources.
1000 Genomes structural-variation extensions must remain separate from the core VCFv4.0 specification unless a specific provision is independently shown to be normative core text.
Do not use VCFv4.1–4.5 text to silently backfill missing VCFv4.0 requirements.
Do not mark VCFv4.0 applicability APPLICABLE until a source is accepted, pinned and reviewed; use SOURCE_NOT_PINNED meanwhile.
